'''September 2001 Rochester, Minnesota tournament (8 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, Minnesota on 8 September 2001. [[Tyler Williams]] won it. It is known from Tyler Williams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3014">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-02-rochester-minnesota-09-08-01-ep1-sealedd3014/ rochester-minnesota-09-08-01-ep1-sealed], DeckTech (Tyler "rugman11" Williams, 2 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-02-rochester-minnesota-09-08-01-ep1-sealedd3014/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Rochester, Minnesota
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Tyler Williams]]
